parameters.query:
INSERT INTO blocks (id, client_id, site_id, tipo, contenido, orden, zona, parent_id, estilos)
VALUES (COALESCE($1::int, nextval('blocks_id_seq')), $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  tipo = EXCLUDED.tipo,
  contenido = EXCLUDED.contenido,
  orden = EXCLUDED.orden,
  zona = EXCLUDED.zona,
  parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id,
  estilos = EXCLUDED.estilos
WHERE blocks.client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id
RETURNING id, site_id, tipo, contenido, orden, zona, parent_id, estilos;
